entities.summary: Noureddin Kianouri was an Iranian construction engineer, urban planner, professor of Bauakademie der DDR in Berlin, and a communist political leader. He studied first at the University of Tehran until 1934 and later in Germany from 1934 to 1939. Before his return to Iran he practiced architecture as well, though he is mostly remembered as a construction engineer in the Munich office of Philipp Holzmann. About a year after foundation of the Tudeh Party he joined the party with the membership number 444 in May 1942.
